title.zh-CN: 发热男孩与既往未解释的肠道病变
title.en: A febrile boy with previously unexplained intestinal lesions

summary.zh-CN: 既往腹部手术曾发现肠道溃疡，当前以发热就诊，消化道症状并不突出。
summary.en: Previous abdominal surgery revealed intestinal ulcers; the current presentation is fever without prominent gastrointestinal symptoms.

finding.zh-CN: 清醒但萎靡，咽稍红，口腔黏膜欠光滑，结膜轻充血；腹软无压痛，右下腹旧手术瘢痕约5 cm。
finding.en: Alert but lethargic, mildly red throat, uneven oral mucosa and mild conjunctival injection; soft non-tender abdomen with an approximately 5 cm old right lower quadrant scar.

text.en: White count 34.3×10^9/L, neutrophils 90%, CRP 160 mg/L and ESR 53 mm/h; radiograph and CT suggested left lower pneumonia.

name.zh-CN: 住院新表现和内镜病理
name.en: New inpatient findings and endoscopic pathology

zh-CN: 住院新表现和内镜病理
en: New inpatient findings and endoscopic pathology

text.zh-CN: 第5天出现多发口腔溃疡，第7天短暂面部红斑，针刺试验阴性。内镜见小肠及结肠多发溃疡；回盲部活检见小血管炎及血管壁纤维素样坏死。
text.en: Multiple oral ulcers appeared on day 5 and transient facial erythema on day 7; pathergy was negative. Endoscopy showed multiple small-bowel and colonic ulcers; ileocaecal biopsy showed small-vessel inflammation with fibrinoid vascular wall necrosis.

text.zh-CN: 美沙拉秦后内镜改善，停药一个月后腹泻发热及巨大穿凿样溃疡复发；加激素后好转，但减量又复发。
text.en: Endoscopy improved with mesalazine; one month after withdrawal, diarrhoea, fever and large punched-out ulcers recurred. Steroids improved symptoms, which relapsed with tapering.

prompt.zh-CN: 早期发热和旧肠道病史应怎样处理？
prompt.en: How should early fever and the previous bowel history be approached?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 治疗已见肺部感染，同时重新评估未解释的肠道病变
text.en: Treat documented pulmonary infection while reassessing unexplained intestinal disease

feedback.zh-CN: 肺炎可解释部分发热，但不能抹去既往多发溃疡。
feedback.en: Pneumonia can explain part of the fever but does not erase previous multifocal ulcers.

text.zh-CN: 没有腹痛就不可能有活动性肠病
text.en: No abdominal pain excludes intestinal disease

feedback.zh-CN: 本例正说明症状可不突出，既往证据仍需调查。
feedback.en: Symptoms may be subtle and previous evidence still requires assessment.

text.zh-CN: 旧手术怀疑已等于克罗恩病确诊
text.en: An earlier suspicion establishes Crohn disease

feedback.zh-CN: 旧资料缺乏明确分类依据，需复核。
feedback.en: The old record lacks definitive classification and requires review.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 后续黏膜表现和血管炎支持原报告的肠型白塞病判断，仍需鉴别其他溃疡原因
text.en: Later mucosal findings and vasculitis support the report’s intestinal Behçet interpretation while requiring differential review

feedback.zh-CN: 组合证据较单一溃疡更有力；阴性针刺不单独排除。
feedback.en: Combined evidence is stronger than an isolated ulcer; negative pathergy alone does not exclude it.

text.zh-CN: 针刺阴性即可排除白塞病
text.en: Negative pathergy excludes Behçet syndrome

feedback.zh-CN: 该试验不是绝对排除试验。
feedback.en: This is not an absolute exclusion test.

text.zh-CN: 所有肠溃疡都等于白塞病
text.en: All intestinal ulcers are Behçet disease

feedback.zh-CN: 感染、药物及其他炎症性肠病仍有鉴别价值。
feedback.en: Infection, drugs and other inflammatory bowel disorders remain relevant.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样讨论当代治疗与随访？
prompt.en: How should current treatment and follow-up be discussed?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 由儿童消化及风湿团队按内镜严重度、鉴别和复发风险制定方案
text.en: Use paediatric gastroenterology/rheumatology review based on endoscopic severity, differential diagnosis and relapse risk

feedback.zh-CN: 现行EULAR更新强调内镜和分层管理；具体儿童方案需专科判断。
feedback.en: The current EULAR update emphasises endoscopy and severity-based management; paediatric regimens require specialist judgement.

text.zh-CN: 症状消失即可自行停药不随访
text.en: Stop treatment independently once symptoms disappear

feedback.zh-CN: 症状与黏膜缓解并不完全等价，复发风险需评估。
feedback.en: Symptoms and mucosal remission are not identical; relapse risk needs review.

text.zh-CN: 只要有效就长期不断加激素
text.en: Keep escalating long-term steroids whenever they work

feedback.zh-CN: 复发和激素负担应促使重新评估治疗策略。
feedback.en: Relapse and steroid burden require reassessment of strategy.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明初诊无腹痛不排除重要肠病。；承认原手术细节、完整现代分类评估及长期结局不全。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Absence of presenting pain does not exclude important bowel disease.; acknowledge Earlier operative details, full modern classification assessment and long-term outcomes are incomplete. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告根据多发肠溃疡、口腔表现和组织血管炎诊断儿童肠型白塞病。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed paediatric intestinal Behçet disease from intestinal ulcers, oral findings and tissue vasculitis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 初诊无腹痛不排除重要肠病。
keyReasoning.en: Absence of presenting pain does not exclude important bowel disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 随时间出现的表现改变鉴别。
组织血管炎需结合临床而非单独定病。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 保留肺炎和系统病并存。
teachingPoints.en: Retain coexisting pneumonia and systemic disease.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 阴性针刺不是绝对排除。
teachingPoints.en: Negative pathergy is not absolute exclusion.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
